title: Chordline
generation_prompt: Original 128-second stereo melodic house instrumental at a fixed 124 BPM in 4/4. Start with the chorus at full level on beat one: four-on-the-floor kick, backbeat clap, offbeat hats, octave bass, bright four-note pluck hook and warm chord stabs all enter together. Never remove the drums or bass. Keep the same energy and an audible beat-by-beat pluck for every 8-second interval, including the first and last. Change chords and melody in the second minute. Cheerful electronic dance music for a family-friendly rhythm game. No intro, build, breakdown, fade, silence, vocals, speech, samples, copying or tempo changes.
cover_prompt: Original comic-print cover: five staggered ivory and cyan piano-roll bars bend upward into a coral open angle; no keyboard, instrument, text, or character. Strong central silhouette at small size.
og_prompt: Purpose-composed horizontal duohertz card with stepped chord bars on the right, lowercase duohertz and Chordline on the left. High-contrast dark editorial layout with subtle print dots.
